opening.argument: The video promotes a TRX arbitrage method with unusually rapid returns: “earn 9 percent in 15 minutes just by watching the video to the end,” alongside a reported “$500 for only 15 minutes” and “over one thousand five hundred dollars in just one round.” It presents a concrete money-moving workflow: buy TRX on Binance, deposit it on a named exchange, convert it to USDT, and withdraw through a TRC20 address. The claimed advantage is that “The Tron exchange rate on this platform is 10% higher than on Binance.” These claims are tied to trading and withdrawal instructions, not merely general discussion. The supplied material does not verify the exchange rates, account ownership, completed profits, or transaction outcomes; a trading screen and transaction-history entries do not establish that a sale or profit occurred.
